title: Add built-in body parsing middleware
description: Provides native JSON and URL‑encoded request body parsing without external dependencies, keeping yantraverse zero‑dependency. The middleware integrates with the existing routing pipeline and offers size limits and error handling for malformed payloads.
testCases: Parse a valid JSON payload and verify req.body contains the object
Parse a valid URL‑encoded payload and verify req.body contains the key/value pairs
Reject a malformed JSON payload with a 400 Bad Request error
Enforce a configurable body size limit and return 413 Payload Too Large when exceeded
acceptance: The middleware correctly populates req.body for JSON and URL‑encoded requests, returns appropriate HTTP errors for malformed or oversized payloads, integrates seamlessly with existing route handlers, and does not introduce any external package dependencies.
reason: Body parsing is a core requirement for most APIs; currently developers must import third‑party parsers, contradicting yantraverse’s zero‑dependency promise. Adding this feature improves developer experience, reduces bundle size, and strengthens the framework’s production readiness.
